comparison: Pinned published Qwen/Qwen3.5-2B reference versus evidence R2, staged notes, complete public chapters
interpretation: Neither model produced a usable key-bullet chapter summary in this four-episode screen.
The upstream Bennett artifact is a paragraph-by-paragraph obligation/qualifier report, not key bullets. Other episodes have no summary artifact.

R2 Bennett repeatedly attempts broken asynchronous helper/delegation code, then writes only the first paragraph's obligation notes and says Done. agent_completed does not prove artifact or semantic completion.
Upstream failure weakens an attribution to training alone. This published reference is not a proven exact unmodified ancestor of R2.

The next direct-probe comparison removes mandatory notes and paragraph bookkeeping while changing prompt and structural bullet feedback. It is a joint workflow intervention, not a one-factor notes ablation.

# Summary - document-summary-v1/source.md

## [chapter-p001]
**Obligation:** Man fritters his income away; wish narrator had half of it.
**Qualifiers:** Regular income, enough for luxuries and needs, not extravagant; always in difficulties; somehow he gets nothing out of his money; excellent flat--half empty!

## [chapter-p002]
**Obligation:** None specified.
**Qualifiers:** At one time or another, in their superior way.

## [chapter-p003]
**Obligation:** None specified.
**Qualifiers:** Recently, in a daily organ; a battle raged round the question whether a woman can exist nicely in the country on L85 a year.

## [chapter-p004]
**Obligation:** None specified.
**Qualifiers:** It is the inexplicable raw material of everything; with it, all is possible; without it, nothing; the supply of time is truly a daily miracle; an affair genuinely astonishing when one examines it.

## [chapter-p005]
**Obligation:** None specified.
**Qualifiers:** It is unstealable; no one receives either more or less than you receive.

## [chapter-p006]
**Obligation:** None specified.
**Qualifiers:** In the realm of time there is no aristocracy of wealth; there is no aristocracy of intellect; genius is never rewarded by even an extra hour a day; there is no punishment; you cannot draw on the future; impossible to get into debt; you can only waste the passing moment; you cannot waste to-morrow; it is kept for you; you cannot waste the next hour; it is kept for you.

## [chapter-p007]
**Obligation:** None specified.
**Qualifiers:** Affair was a miracle; is it not?

## [chapter-p008]
**Obligation:** None specified.
**Qualifiers:** Twenty-four hours of daily time; health, pleasure, money, content, respect, evolution of immortal soul; your happiness--the elusive prize that you are all clutching for, my friends!--depends on that; strange that the newspapers, so enterprising and up-to-date as they are, are not full of 'How to live on a given income of time,' instead of 'How to live on a given income of money'!; money is far commoner than time; when one reflects, one perceives that money is just about the commonest thing there is; it encumbers the earth in gross heaps.

## [chapter-p009]
**Obligation:** None specified.
**Qualifiers:** Can't contrive to live on a certain income of money; one braces the muscles and makes it guineas, and balances the budget; but if one cannot arrange that an income of twenty-four hours a day shall exactly cover all proper items of expenditure; one does muddle one's life definitely; the supply of time, though gloriously regular, is cruelly restricted.

## [chapter-p010]
**Obligation:** None specified.
**Qualifiers:** I do not mean exists; which of us is free from that uneasy feeling; which of us is quite sure; which of us is not; which of us has not been saying to himself all his life; I shall alter that when I have a little more time.

## [chapter-p011]
**Obligation:** None specified.
**Qualifiers:** We have, and we have always had; it is the realisation of this profound and neglected truth; which, by the way, I have not discovered.
